verdict.rationale: YYLO's integrations can bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into its kanban, and Ledger stores typed task records with intent, status, blockers and responses. That partially covers turning incoming requests into structured tasks. Nothing shows feedback being analyzed or tasks being generated with a proposed scope, and the tool is aimed at developers and operators rather than product managers. Missing for 10: dedicated feedback-submission intake, automated scope proposal or spec generation from feedback, PM-oriented workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
